notes: Synthetic slot names (decimal, signed, spaced, non-digit), view-slot type tables and eight 0xe5-byte unit-type records with name pointers and page-text flags. The lookup 0x9ddfc (returns the varying log pointer), scene word 0x9125c (fixed result incl. zero), page text 0x9e508 and simSyncSlots 0x7de5c are replaced in both runs by loggers of their register inputs; atoi 0x9d4cd runs as original.
